privacyPolicy.subtitle: How {entity} collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use {brand} — including payment processing through Stripe.
privacyPolicy.stripeHighlight.title: Payments Processed by Stripe
privacyPolicy.stripeHighlight.descriptio: When you purchase app testing services, your payment card details are collected and processed directly by Stripe, Inc. We never store your full card number. Stripe's privacy practices are described at stripe.com/privacy.
privacyPolicy.sections.whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
privacyPolicy.sections.whoWeAre.dataCont: {entity} operating as {brand} is the data controller responsible for your personal information. We provide professional Android app testing services to help developers meet Google Play Store testing requirements. Our registered business address is {address}. For privacy inquiries, contact us at contact@fasttesters.com or call +213 549 17 93 03.
privacyPolicy.sections.whoWeAre.scope.de: This Privacy Policy applies to all personal information collected through fasttesters.com, our web application, customer support channels, and payment flows. By using our Services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this policy.
privacyPolicy.sections.dataSharing.strip: When you make a payment, your payment card details are collected and processed directly by Stripe, Inc. We do not store your full credit card number on our servers. Stripe's use of your personal information is governed by Stripe's Privacy Policy (stripe.com/privacy). We share your name, email address, and order details with Stripe to process transactions and prevent fraud.
privacyPolicy.sections.dataSharing.legal: We may disclose your information when required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request, or when we believe disclosure is necessary to protect our rights, your safety, or the safety of others.
privacyPolicy.sections.legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
privacyPolicy.sections.legalBasis.contra: We process your personal data to fulfill our contract with you — delivering app testing services you have purchased, managing your account, and communicating about your orders.
privacyPolicy.sections.legalBasis.legiti: We process certain data based on our legitimate interests, including improving our Services, preventing fraud, ensuring platform security, and analyzing usage patterns. We balance these interests against your rights and freedoms.
privacyPolicy.sections.legalBasis.legalO: We may process and retain certain data to comply with legal obligations, including tax and accounting requirements, and to respond to lawful requests from authorities.
privacyPolicy.sections.legalBasis.consen: Where required by law, we obtain your consent before processing your data for specific purposes, such as marketing communications. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before withdrawal.
privacyPolicy.sections.yourRights.portab: You have the right to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format and to transmit it to another controller where technically feasible.
privacyPolicy.sections.yourRights.object: You have the right to object to processing of your personal data based on legitimate interests. We will cease processing unless we demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds that override your interests.
privacyPolicy.sections.yourRights.restri: You have the right to request restriction of processing in certain circumstances, such as when you contest the accuracy of your data or object to processing.
privacyPolicy.sections.yourRights.compla: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory data protection authority in your country of residence if you believe we have not handled your data in accordance with applicable law.
privacyPolicy.sections.dataRetention.acc: We retain your account information for as long as your account is active. If you close your account, we delete personal data within 30 days, except where longer retention is required by law.
privacyPolicy.sections.dataRetention.tra: Payment and order records are retained for 7 years to comply with tax, accounting, and financial regulations.
privacyPolicy.sections.dataRetention.tes: App testing data (package names, testing links, feedback) is retained for the duration of the testing period plus 90 days, after which it is anonymized or deleted unless you request earlier deletion.
privacyPolicy.sections.dataRetention.sup: Emails and support tickets are retained for 2 years to help us resolve disputes and improve our service quality.
privacyPolicy.sections.internationalTran: {brand} operates globally. Your personal data may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your country of residence, including the United States, where data protection laws may differ from those in your jurisdiction.

When transferring data internationally, we implement appropriate safeguards including Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission, and we ensure our service providers maintain adequate data protection standards.
privacyPolicy.sections.childrenPrivacy.a: Our Services are not directed to individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child without parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information promptly.
privacyPolicy.sections.childrenPrivacy.p: If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us at contact@fasttesters.com and we will investigate and take appropriate action.
privacyPolicy.sections.ccpa.title: California Privacy Rights (CCPA)
California residents have the right to request information about the categories and specific pieces of personal information we have collected, the sources, purposes, and third parties with whom we share it.
privacyPolicy.sections.ccpa.rightToDelet: California residents may request deletion of personal information we have collected, subject to certain exceptions required by law.
privacyPolicy.sections.ccpa.rightToOptOu: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We do not share your data for cross-context behavioral advertising.
privacyPolicy.sections.ccpa.nonDiscrimin: We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your California privacy rights. To exercise these rights, contact contact@fasttesters.com.
privacyPolicy.sections.cookies.analytics: We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our website. These cookies collect anonymized usage data. You can opt out via our cookie consent banner or your browser settings. See our Cookie Policy for full details.
privacyPolicy.sections.changes.title: Changes to This Policy
privacyPolicy.sections.changes.updates.d: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. We will post the updated policy on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.
privacyPolicy.sections.changes.materialC: If we make material changes that significantly affect your rights, we will notify you by email (if you have an account) or by posting a prominent notice on our website before the changes take effect.
privacyPolicy.contact.description: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, contact our customer service team by email, phone, or mail at our registered business address:
termsPolicy.subtitle: The service agreement governing your use of {brand} app testing services — pricing, delivery, cancellations, refunds, and your responsibilities as a customer.
termsPolicy.serviceHighlight.title: What You Are Purchasing
termsPolicy.serviceHighlight.description: Each order is a one-time $15 USD payment for professional Android app testing: 15 testers for 16 days to help you meet Google Play closed-testing requirements. No subscriptions. No hidden fees.
termsPolicy.sections.about.title: About Fast Testers
termsPolicy.sections.about.p1: {brand} is a professional app testing service operated by {entity} that helps Android developers meet Google Play Store's closed testing and production access requirements.
termsPolicy.sections.about.p2: We assign 15 professional testers to evaluate your app over a 16-day testing period. Our standard service fee is $15 USD per app, charged as a one-time payment with no recurring subscriptions.
termsPolicy.sections.about.p3: For questions about our services, contact us at contact@fasttesters.com, call +213 549 17 93 03, or write to us at {address}. We aim to respond to all inquiries within 1–2 business days.
termsPolicy.sections.eligibility.title: Eligibility
termsPolicy.sections.eligibility.p1: You must be at least 16 years of age to use our Services. By using our Services, you represent and warrant that you meet this age requirement.
termsPolicy.sections.eligibility.p2: You must have the legal authority to enter into these Terms. If you are using the Services on behalf of a company or organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that entity to these Terms.
termsPolicy.sections.eligibility.p3: Our Services are intended for developers and businesses seeking Google Play testing compliance. You must comply with all applicable laws in your jurisdiction when using our Services.
termsPolicy.sections.acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
termsPolicy.sections.acceptableUse.p1: You agree not to submit apps that contain illegal content, malware, spyware, or material that violates Google Play Store policies or applicable laws.
termsPolicy.sections.acceptableUse.p2: You agree not to use our Services to test apps designed to deceive users, impersonate other apps, distribute spam, or engage in fraudulent activity.
termsPolicy.sections.acceptableUse.p3: You agree not to attempt to circumvent our payment system, abuse our refund or guarantee policies, or use our platform for any purpose other than legitimate app testing.
termsPolicy.sections.acceptableUse.p4: You agree not to reverse engineer, scrape, or attempt to gain unauthorized access to our platform, systems, or other users' data.
termsPolicy.sections.acceptableUse.p5: Violation of this Acceptable Use policy may result in immediate termination of your account and forfeiture of any fees paid, without refund.
termsPolicy.sections.orderFulfillment.p1: Upon successful payment, you will receive a confirmation email with your order details. Testing services begin once we assign testers to your app, typically within 6 hours of payment.
termsPolicy.sections.orderFulfillment.p2: You are responsible for providing a valid Google Play closed testing link and ensuring your app is accessible to testers throughout the testing period.
termsPolicy.sections.orderFulfillment.p3: Our service is considered delivered once the full 16-day testing period has been completed and testing results have been made available in your account dashboard.
termsPolicy.sections.orderFulfillment.p4: We are not responsible for delays caused by incorrect testing links, app unavailability, Google Play policy changes, or factors outside our reasonable control.
termsPolicy.sections.indemnification.p1: You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless {entity}, its officers, directors, employees, and agents from any claims, damages, losses, liabilities, and expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising from your use of the Services, your app content, your violation of these Terms, or your violation of any third-party rights.
termsPolicy.sections.indemnification.p2: This indemnification obligation survives termination of your account and these Terms.
termsPolicy.sections.disclaimer.title: Disclaimer of Warranties
termsPolicy.sections.disclaimer.p1: THE SERVICES ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, WHETHER EXPRESS, IMPLIED, OR STATUTORY, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, AND NON-INFRINGEMENT.
termsPolicy.sections.disclaimer.p2: We do not warrant that our Services will result in Google Play approval or production access. Google Play's review decisions are made solely by Google and are outside our control.
termsPolicy.sections.disclaimer.p3: We do not warrant that the Services will be uninterrupted, error-free, or free of viruses or other harmful components.
termsPolicy.sections.disputeResolution.p: Before initiating any formal dispute, you agree to contact us at contact@fasttesters.com and attempt to resolve the matter through good-faith negotiation for at least 30 days.

If negotiation fails, any dispute arising from these Terms or the Services shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with applicable arbitration rules, except where prohibited by law.
You agree to bring any claim individually and not as part of a class action. Nothing in this section prevents either party from seeking injunctive relief in a court of competent jurisdiction.
termsPolicy.sections.legalRestrictions.p: Our Services are available worldwide to Android app developers aged 16 and older. You must comply with all applicable laws in your jurisdiction, including Google Play Developer Program policies and export control regulations.

We do not provide services for apps containing illegal content, malware, gambling where prohibited, adult content without proper age gates, or apps that violate intellectual property rights. We reserve the right to refuse or discontinue service for any app that violates applicable law or platform policies.
All prices are displayed in US Dollars (USD). Sales tax or VAT may apply depending on your location and will be shown at checkout where required by law.
Payments are processed by Stripe, Inc. By completing a purchase, you also agree to Stripe's applicable terms of service and privacy policy available at stripe.com/legal.
termsPolicy.sections.governingLaw.p1: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Wyoming, United States, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.
termsPolicy.sections.governingLaw.p2: Any disputes not subject to arbitration shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Sheridan County, Wyoming, United States.
termsPolicy.sections.generalProvisions.p: Severability: If any provision of these Terms is found to be unenforceable, the remaining provisions will continue in full force and effect.
Entire Agreement: These Terms, together with our Privacy Policy, Refund Policy, and Cancellation Policy, constitute the entire agreement between you and {entity} regarding the Services.
Waiver: Our failure to enforce any right or provision of these Terms shall not constitute a waiver of that right or provision.
Assignment: You may not assign your rights under these Terms without our prior written consent. We may assign our rights without restriction.
termsPolicy.contact.description: If you have any questions about these Terms and Conditions, contact our customer service team:
refundPolicyPage.subtitle: Refund, return, and cancellation terms for {brand} digital app testing services — processed securely via Stripe.
refundPolicyPage.intro: This Refund and Return Policy applies to digital app testing services sold by {entity} through the {brand} website at fasttesters.com. All payments are processed securely by Stripe, Inc. Because we deliver digital services rather than physical goods, our return process is handled through order cancellation (before service delivery) or refund requests (after service delivery) as described below.
refundPolicyPage.cancellationHowTo: To cancel before testing begins, email contact@fasttesters.com with your order reference or call +213 549 17 93 03. Approved cancellations are refunded to your original payment method via Stripe within 5–10 business days.
refundPolicyPage.sections.cancellation.p: You may cancel your order and receive a full refund if you request cancellation before we assign testers to your app (typically within 6 hours of payment). See our Cancellation Policy for full details.

Once testers have been assigned and the 16-day testing period has begun, the digital service is considered delivered and cannot be cancelled. Refunds after delivery are available only under the Production Access Guarantee described below.
refundPolicyPage.sections.returnPolicy.p: {brand} sells digital app testing services, not physical products. Because our service is delivered electronically and begins immediately after tester assignment, traditional product returns do not apply.

If you are unsatisfied with our service, you may request a refund under our Production Access Guarantee if Google Play rejects your app after you complete the full testing period and meet all eligibility criteria outlined below.
If you have not yet received the service (testers not assigned), you may cancel your order for a full refund — this is equivalent to returning an undelivered product.

All refund and return requests must be submitted to contact@fasttesters.com or by phone at +213 549 17 93 03. Include your order reference, app package name, and account email. We respond within 1–2 business days.
refundPolicyPage.sections.chargebacks.p1: If you have a concern about a charge, please contact us at contact@fasttesters.com before initiating a chargeback with your bank or card issuer. We are committed to resolving billing issues fairly and promptly.
refundPolicyPage.sections.chargebacks.p2: Initiating a chargeback without first contacting us may delay resolution and may result in account suspension while the dispute is investigated.
refundPolicyPage.sections.chargebacks.p3: Approved refunds are processed through Stripe to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.
refundPolicyPage.contact.description: If you have any questions about our Refund and Return Policy or need assistance with a refund request, contact our customer service team:
cancellationPolicyPage.subtitle: How to cancel orders and close your account with {brand}. No subscriptions — each purchase is a single $15 payment per app.
cancellationPolicyPage.introFull: This Cancellation Policy explains how you can cancel orders and close your account with {entity} ({brand}). We provide one-time app testing services — we do not operate subscription or recurring billing models. Please read this policy alongside our Refund Policy and Terms and Conditions.
cancellationPolicyPage.sections.noSubscr: {brand} operates on a pay-per-app model. Each purchase is a one-time payment of $15 USD per app submitted for testing. We do not offer subscription plans, recurring billing, or automatic renewals.
You will never be charged again unless you voluntarily submit another app for testing. There are no monthly fees, annual fees, or hidden recurring charges of any kind.
Because there are no subscriptions, there is nothing to "cancel" in the traditional subscription sense. This policy explains how you can cancel individual orders and close your account.
cancellationPolicyPage.sections.beforeTe: You may cancel your order and receive a full refund if you request cancellation before we have assigned testers to your app. We typically begin tester assignment within 6 hours of payment confirmation.

To cancel an order before testing begins, email contact@fasttesters.com with the subject line "Order Cancellation" and include your app package name and the email address associated with your {brand} account.

If testers have already been assigned to your app, the testing service is considered in progress and the order cannot be cancelled. At that point, our Refund Policy applies only under the conditions described in our Production Access Guarantee.
We will confirm your cancellation request within 1–2 business days. Approved cancellations are refunded to your original payment method within 5–7 business days via Stripe.
cancellationPolicyPage.sections.cannotCa: Once the testing period has started (testers have been assigned and your app testing link is active), the order cannot be cancelled because our testers have committed time and resources to your project.
Orders cannot be cancelled after the 16-day testing period has been completed, regardless of the outcome of your Google Play submission.
Partial cancellations or refunds for partially completed testing periods are not available. Our service is delivered as a complete package.
If you believe your order was placed in error after testing has begun, please contact us. While we cannot guarantee a refund, we will review your situation on a case-by-case basis.
cancellationPolicyPage.sections.vsRefund: Cancellation applies when you stop an order before service delivery begins. A full refund is issued automatically upon approved cancellation.

Refunds after service delivery are governed by our separate Refund Policy and are available only under our Production Access Guarantee — when Google Play rejects your app after you have completed the full testing period and met all eligibility criteria.
These are two distinct processes. Cancellation is for orders not yet started; refunds are for completed services that did not achieve the guaranteed outcome.
cancellationPolicyPage.sections.accountC: You may close your {brand} account at any time by emailing contact@fasttesters.com with the subject line "Account Closure Request."

Account closure does not automatically cancel active testing orders. If you have an order in progress, the testing service will continue until completion unless you separately request order cancellation (subject to the rules above).
Upon account closure, we will delete your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy, except where retention is required by law or for legitimate business purposes (e.g., financial records).
Closing your account does not entitle you to a refund for any completed or in-progress orders.
cancellationPolicyPage.sections.chargeba: If you have a concern about a charge, please contact us at contact@fasttesters.com before initiating a chargeback with your bank or card issuer. We are committed to resolving issues fairly and promptly.
Initiating a chargeback without first contacting us may result in suspension of your account and may delay resolution of your concern.
All payment disputes are processed in accordance with our Terms and Conditions and applicable payment network rules.
cancellationPolicyPage.contact.title: Contact Us
cancellationPolicyPage.contact.descripti: To cancel an order, close your account, or ask questions about this policy, contact our support team. We aim to respond within 1–2 business days.
cancellationPolicyPage.contact.responseT: We aim to respond to all cancellation requests within 1–2 business days.
